title: Performance in the field: start-up time, dropped frames and battery

videos.script:
The app was fast on your phone. {{yours}} Your phone is new, charged, and has nothing else running. Most of the people using the planner have none of those things.

Performance in the field is measured on their phones, not yours. {{field}} How long the app takes to open, how many frames it drops while scrolling, and how much battery it costs in the background.

Today you read a week of start-up times the way the stores report them. {{percentiles}} Not as an average, which hides exactly the people who are suffering, but as percentiles, split by kind of phone.

And you will see why the slowest tenth matters more than the middle. {{tail}} They are the ones who leave, and the ones whose reviews other people read.
